candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy recalled his association with the ABVP and said Prime Minister Narendra Modi should win people’s hearts rather than divide the nation. He also criticised the Centre over Telangana projects and discussed education, language and the TDP.

candidates.title: Congress Plans To Enrol 7 Lakh Graduate Voters
candidates.excerpt: Congress has set a target of enrolling around seven lakh graduate voters in each of Telangana’s two Graduate MLC constituencies for the 2027 polls.
